name: Neuronpedia
summary: Open-source interpretability platform for browsing and searching sparse-autoencoder features/latents across many open models, tracing attribution graphs/circuits, and steering model behavior by editing activations.

name: Granite Guardian
summary: Family of compact judge models that classify LLM prompts and responses for safety risks (jailbreak, bias, violence, sexual content), RAG hallucination/groundedness, and agentic function-call correctness, with support for custom criteria.

name: ICX360
summary: Toolkit of context-attribution explainability methods for LLMs: MExGen attributes generated text to parts of the input context, CELL builds contrastive edited prompts to show what drives different outputs, and Token Highlighter flags gradient-critical tokens for jailbreak detection.

name: Contextual Privacy for LLMs
summary: Local pipeline that detects a user's intent behind a query, identifies which prompt details are unnecessary for that intent, and reformulates the prompt to strip out-of-context private information before it reaches a conversational agent.
